description: The true path of the miniature: every way into the room closed to a person, something that got through all the same, the way it came found, and a route from the yard to the bench that only something small that climbs could take.

moves.why: Locked all night, the key at my belt: nobody came by the door.
Barred: no person comes through a hand's breadth.
A draught came in from the yard, so there is a way nobody has mentioned.
The way the draught came: a gap for something small.

moves.see: small enough for the open pane
moves.why: Whatever took the ring had to fit that.
Start where the draught came from.
The roller of the blind is beside it.
The cord hangs from the roller.
And it reaches the bench, where the ring lay.

moves.see: able to climb down a cord
moves.why: It must have come that way, and gone back up it.

moves.see: nothing came in by the door
moves.why: The door was locked all night.

moves.see: no person came in by the window
moves.why: And the bars stop a person.
Tom knew of the ring, but no person could get in.

moves.see: loose in the yard after dark
moves.why: One thing small enough, that climbs, was loose in the yard that night.
